source_text: Septem boves et spicae. Spiritus Dei in eo. Anulus et collum aureum — gloria secundi post regem.
pass_a_gloss: Seven cows and ears. Spirit of-God in him. Ring and neck golden — glory second after king.
pass_b_english: [[Seven cows and ears >> Bible:Genesis 41:1-7]]. [[The Spirit of God is in him >> Bible:Genesis 41:38]]. Ring and gold collar — glory second after the king.
